name: jan
description: Agent skills for Jan, the offline ChatGPT alternative: serving local models with the jan CLI, the desktop Local API Server, and headless Jan Agent runs.

interface.shortDescription: Local models, local API, Jan Agent
interface.longDescription: Skills for Jan, the open-source assistant that runs models fully offline. Covers serving LlamaCPP or MLX models with jan serve and wiring Claude Code or OpenClaw to them with jan launch; configuring and calling the desktop app's OpenAI-compatible Local API Server (API key, trusted hosts, CORS, server-side MCP tools); and running Jan Agent headless in scripts and CI with safety flags, turn and budget limits, JSON output and exit codes.
defaultPrompt: Serve a local Qwen model with Jan and point my app at it
Expose Jan's API server to my phone on the LAN safely
Run Jan Agent in CI with a turn limit and parse the JSON result
